yasmin-medrano.metaTitle: Yasmin Medrano — Aesthetic Clinic Website | Case Study
yasmin-medrano.metaDesc: How we built the complete digital presence for a premium aesthetic medicine practice. Case study by MS Saravia Tech Stack.
yasmin-medrano.challenge: Premium aesthetic clinics live and die on trust and first impressions, yet many rely on generic templates or social media alone. Prospective patients struggled to discover treatments, gauge credibility, and book a consultation without friction.
yasmin-medrano.solution: We built a complete digital presence — a polished treatments and services showcase, a modern booking flow, and a cohesive brand identity — designed to turn first-time visitors into booked consultations and reflect the quality of the practice.

readycv.metaTitle: ReadyCV — AI Resume Builder | Case Study
readycv.metaDesc: How we built ReadyCV, an AI-powered resume builder helping professionals land their dream jobs. Case study by MS Saravia Tech Stack.
readycv.challenge: Job seekers know a strong, tailored CV is decisive, but writing one that reads well and passes automated screening is slow and intimidating. Most resume tools stop at rigid templates and leave the hardest part — the words — to the user.
readycv.solution: We built ReadyCV, an AI-powered resume builder that helps professionals craft compelling, role-tailored CVs in minutes. It guides users through structured input and generates polished, ATS-friendly content, turning a blank page into an interview-ready resume.

nova-nutrition.metaTitle: NOVA Nutrition — AI Nutrition App | Case Study
nova-nutrition.metaDesc: NOVA Nutrition: smart, AI-powered nutrition tracking for iOS and Android. Case study by MS Saravia Tech Stack.
nova-nutrition.challenge: Consistent nutrition tracking is where most health goals fall apart — manual logging is tedious, generic meal plans ignore individual context, and feedback arrives too late to change behavior. People need guidance that adapts to them in the moment.
nova-nutrition.solution: We are building NOVA, an iOS and Android app that uses AI for smart nutrition tracking, personalized meal plans, and real-time insights. It reduces logging friction and turns everyday food choices into actionable, individualized guidance.

estimator.label: App cost estimator
estimator.title: What would your app cost?
estimator.subtitle: A quick, honest ballpark in USD — adjusted to your region. Not a quote, but a real starting point.
estimator.regionHint: Auto-detected from your location — switch if needed.

platformHint.hybrid: React Native / Flutter — iOS + Android from a single codebase. Best value.
platformHint.ios: Native Swift / SwiftUI for iPhone & iPad.
platformHint.native: Two separate native codebases — maximum performance, higher cost.
platformHint.webapp: A progressive web app — runs in the browser, installable, no app stores. Fast to ship.
platformHint.landing: A marketing site or landing page — few screens, fast, no app store.
platformHint.aiagent: A custom AI assistant or agent (chatbot, RAG, automations) wired to your data & tools.

tierHint.mvp: Core idea, a handful of screens — validate fast.
tierHint.standard: Full product: several flows, polished UI, real users.
tierHint.complex: Many modules, integrations, scale from day one.

estimator.disclaimer: Ballpark only — final price depends on scope, design and integrations. Maintenance runs ~15-20% of the build per year.

designHint.template: Proven UI kit adapted to your brand — fastest, most affordable.
designHint.standard: Custom design tailored to your product and users.
designHint.premium: Bespoke visual identity, motion and micro-interactions.

complianceHint.standard: Data privacy, consent and GDPR-style handling.
complianceHint.regulated: Health, finance or sensitive data — audits, encryption, PCI/HIPAA. Adds significant scope.

estimator.includedNote: Includes design, development, QA and project management.
estimator.regionAuto: Detected from your location — pricing is set automatically.
estimator.categoryHint: The type of app shapes the baseline scope and price.
